mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO release_sql_log (plan_id, step_id, step_no, run_seq, operator, file_name, seq, sql_preview, status, duration_ms, error_msg, executed_at) VALUES
(#{r.planId}, #{r.stepId}, #{r.stepNo}, #{r.runSeq}, #{r.operator}, #{r.fileName}, #{r.seq}, #{r.sqlPreview}, #{r.status}, #{r.durationMs}, #{r.errorMsg,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, now())
mapper.select: SELECT step_no AS "stepNo", count(*) AS "total", count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'FAIL') AS "failCount" FROM release_sql_log WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND run_seq = (SELECT max(run_seq) FROM release_sql_log WHERE plan_id = #{planId}) GROUP BY step_no ORDER BY step_no
